full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 250

Lixin County MouDa Financing Guarantee Co., Ltd. v. Anhui MouAn Construction Group Co., Ltd., Lixin County MouTeng Real Estate Co., Ltd. — third-party revocation action

(Discussed and adopted by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on March 12, 2025)

**Keywords**  
Civil; third-party revocation action; priority of compensation for construction project price; relative waiver; liquidation priority  

**Ruling Gist**  

Where the contractor of a construction in progress undertakes to the mortgagee of such construction to waive its priority of compensation for the construction project price, the people's court shall examine whether such waiver impairs the interests of construction workers. If the interests of construction workers are impaired, the waiver is invalid; if the interests of workers are not impaired, the waiver is valid, but only produces the effect that the liquidation priority of the claim for the construction project price is inferior to that of the mortgage right *vis-à-vis* such mortgagee. Where other creditors of the employer contend that the contractor does not enjoy the priority of compensation for the construction project price based on such waiver, the people's court shall not support such contention.

**Basic Facts**  

Between 2011 and 2012, Lixin County MouTeng Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "MouTeng Real Estate") conducted a tender for Phase I of Zone C and Zone D and Phase II of Zone C of a certain property development project in Anhui. Anhui MouAn Construction Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "MouAn Construction") won the bid and entered into a construction project construction contract with MouTeng Real Estate to undertake the project at issue.  

In January 2016, MouTeng Real Estate commissioned a third party to apply to Anhui Lixin Mou Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. for a one-year project loan of RMB 29,000,000 (the same currency applies hereinafter). Lixin County MouDa Financing Guarantee Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "MouDa Guarantee") provided a guarantee for this loan, and MouTeng Real Estate mortgaged certain properties (108 units) of Building No. 10 in Zone D of the property development under construction to MouDa Guarantee as a counter-guarantee mortgage. In the same month, MouAn Construction, as the contractor, issued a "Declaration of Construction Contractor for Mortgage of Construction in Progress," undertaking that: "1. Our company fully understands and believes that the borrowed funds will be entirely used for the construction of the property development project; 2. Before all claims secured by MouDa Guarantee's guarantee are fully satisfied, we waive the priority of compensation for the realization value of the constructed buildings arising from the settlement of project funds, and unconditionally cooperate with MouDa Guarantee in the exercise of its mortgage rights in accordance with the law."  

In May 2017, because the third party failed to repay the aforesaid loan when due, MouDa Guarantee completed the subrogation. In June of the same year, MouDa Guarantee initiated an action concerning a right of recourse dispute before the Bozhou Intermediate People's Court of Anhui Province, seeking repayment of the subrogated principal, interest, and liquidated damages from MouTeng Real Estate and others. Thereafter, the parties reached a mediation agreement, and the court confirmed and issued Civil Mediation Paper No. (2017) Wan 16 Min Chu 212, requiring MouTeng Real Estate and others to repay the subrogated principal, interest, and liquidated damages.  

In 2018, the construction of the project at issue was completed. Subsequently, due to a dispute over project funds, MouAn Construction sued MouTeng Real Estate before the court in a dispute over a construction project construction contract, requesting a judgment ordering MouTeng Real Estate to pay the outstanding project funds and overdue interest, and confirming that MouAn Construction enjoyed a priority right of compensation on the project at issue (Zone C and Zone D of the property development in Anhui) within the scope of the aforesaid project price upon auction or sale. On April 17, 2020, the Bozhou Intermediate People's Court of Anhui Province rendered Civil Judgment No. (2019) Wan 16 Min Chu 248, ordering MouTeng Real Estate to pay MouAn Construction outstanding project funds of RMB 48,733,386 and interest, and confirming that MouAn Construction enjoyed a priority right of compensation on the auction or sale proceeds of Zone C and Zone D of the property development in Anhui within the scope of the outstanding project funds payable by MouTeng Real Estate. Upon appeal by both MouTeng Real Estate and MouAn Construction, the Anhui High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment No. (2020) Wan Min Zhong 831 on December 22, 2020, affirming the original judgment.  

Thereafter, MouDa Guarantee filed a third-party revocation action (i.e., this case), contending that MouAn Construction had failed to truthfully disclose in the aforementioned construction project construction contract dispute that it had previously made a declaration waiving its priority right of compensation, and that the said judgments hindered MouDa Guarantee from fully realizing its claims in the enforcement of Civil Mediation Paper No. (2017) Wan 16 Min Chu 212. Therefore, MouDa Guarantee requested the revocation of the judgment items in Civil Judgment No. (2019) Wan 16 Min Chu 248 and Civil Judgment No. (2020) Wan Min Zhong 831 that confirmed MouAn Construction's priority of compensation for the construction project price.

**Judgment**  

The Anhui High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment No. (2021) Wan Min Che 2 on December 30, 2021, dismissing Lixin County MouDa Financing Guarantee Co., Ltd.'s claims. After the judgment was pronounced, Lixin County MouDa Financing Guarantee Co., Ltd., being dissatisfied, appealed. The Supreme People's Court rendered Civil Judgment No. (2022) Zui Gao Fa Min Zhong 233 on November 18, 2022, dismissing the appeal and affirming the original judgment.

**Reasoning**  

The issue in dispute in this case is: How to determine the validity of MouAn Construction's undertaking to MouDa Guarantee to waive its priority of compensation for the construction project price?  

Article 23 of the *Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts (II)* (Fa Shi [2018] No. 20) provides: "Where the employer and the contractor agree to waive or restrict the priority of compensation for the construction project price, and such waiver or restriction impairs the interests of construction workers, and the employer contends on the basis of such agreement that the contractor does not enjoy the priority of compensation for the construction project price, the people's court shall not support such contention." Accordingly, the key to determining the validity of a contractor's waiver of the priority of compensation for the construction project price is whether it impairs the interests of construction workers.  

In this case, although the *Declaration of Construction Contractor for Mortgage of Construction in Progress* was made by the contractor MouAn Construction to MouDa Guarantee, a creditor of the employer, rather than directly to the employer MouTeng Real Estate, its core content was still that MouAn Construction disposed of the priority of compensation for the construction project price, and the validity assessment shall still apply the provisions of the aforementioned judicial interpretation. Upon examination, MouAn Construction's undertaking to the mortgagee MouDa Guarantee to waive its priority of compensation for the construction project price with respect to the mortgaged properties was intended to secure MouDa Guarantee's guarantee for the project loan, thereby ensuring that the project obtained necessary financial support. It did not have the illegal purpose of impairing the interests of construction workers. Moreover, the 108 properties subject to the waiver of priority of compensation for the construction project price accounted for only approximately 4.5% of the total construction area undertaken by MouAn Construction, with an appraised value of RMB 22,373,538. MouAn Construction still enjoyed the priority of compensation for the construction project price with respect to the remaining properties accounting for 95.5% of the total construction area. Therefore, this waiver undertaking did not affect the satisfaction of its claim for project funds and interest of RMB 48,733,386 against MouTeng Real Estate, nor would it impair the legitimate interests of the construction workers. In the absence of any other grounds for invalidity, the waiver shall be deemed valid.  

The priority of compensation for the construction project price confers on the contractor's claim for project funds the effect of being satisfied in priority over mortgage rights and ordinary claims from the proceeds of sale of the building. When a building is simultaneously subject to multiple rights such as a claim for project funds, mortgage rights, and ordinary claims, the claim for project funds enjoys a relatively superior liquidation priority. In this case, MouAn Construction did not manifest an intention to waive the priority of satisfaction to other creditors of MouTeng Real Estate; therefore, the waiver was relative and partial. Accordingly, the above conduct only resulted in the consequence that MouAn Construction's claim for project funds with respect to the 108 properties at issue could not be satisfied in priority over MouDa Guarantee's mortgage rights, but did not lead to the absolute extinction of MouAn Construction's priority of compensation for the construction project price. *Vis-à-vis* other mortgagees and ordinary creditors of MouTeng Real Estate, MouAn Construction still enjoyed the priority of compensation for the construction project price under the law. Therefore, Civil Judgment No. (2019) Wan 16 Min Chu 248 and Civil Judgment No. (2020) Wan Min Zhong 831, which confirmed that MouAn Construction enjoyed a priority right of compensation on the auction or sale proceeds of Zone C and Zone D of the property development in Anhui within the scope of the outstanding project funds payable by MouTeng Real Estate, were in accordance with the law. As for the priority of MouDa Guarantee's mortgage right over MouAn Construction's claim for project funds in terms of satisfaction, such priority was not affected by law, and MouDa Guarantee's interest in that priority could be protected in the actual enforcement process.  

In summary, the court did not support MouDa Guarantee's claim to revoke the judgment items in Civil Judgment No. (2019) Wan 16 Min Chu 248 and Civil Judgment No. (2020) Wan Min Zhong 831 that confirmed MouAn Construction's priority of compensation for the construction project price.

**Relevant Legal Provisions**  

Article 807 of the *Civil Code of the People's Republic of China* (this case applies Article 286 of the *Contract Law of the People's Republic of China*, which took effect on October 1, 1999)  

Article 42 of the *Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts (I)* (Fa Shi [2020] No. 25) [this case applies Article 23 of the *Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Construction Contracts (II)* (Fa Shi [2018] No. 20), which took effect on February 1, 2019]
